name: Capitol Reef National Park
tagline: Capitol Reef — orchard valley and red cliffs; short scenic drive stops.

practical.ticket_note: Entrance pass for scenic drive areas.
practical.transit_note: Torrey gateway; scenic drive is the main slice.
practical.energy_note: Sun and dry air; little shade on rocks.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → Fruita area → one scenic pullout
practical.season_note: Orchard fruit seasons vary; roads can close in storms.
